BL-691 — Ambulance mode's first live run moved everything except the patient: the sync deliver path ignores the hold, no gate lets the patient's parcel outrank a busy resident, and engaging on a paused ticket is a silent deadlock
What it solves: Gherkin parked as `.feature.draft` per BL-233; the coder promotes it and
wires handlers in the same commit. New file rather than appending to
`specs/features/BL-655-ambulance-mode-hold.feature`, which stays live and
unchanged.
Approval context: Two things want your eye before this is scheduled. (1) SEVERITY. You wrote "high" in the intake and also "do not expedite". Those now conflict mechanically: Article 3.2.4 makes every `high` defect jump the whole queue automatically. I have written `medium` so the lane obeys your do-not-expedite dir…
BL-691 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-691" (or "reject BL-691 <reason>") to act.
